model_reconciliation.reconciliation_explanation: The pilot reported 195.66 MB because two interrupted temporary download files ('model.tmp.16336.2464' of 68.38 MB and 'model.tmp.3888.15404' of 40.63 MB) from concurrent earlier runs remained inside the ~/.mesh/models directory. The true, clean model asset footprint is exactly 86.66 MB (86.22 MB model.onnx + 0.44 MB tokenizer.json). Temporary download artifacts are not part of steady-state disk requirements.
